plan.problems:
1. BI asymmetry across arms: the tree boot inherits the determinism-bind env (VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 + FR13_BI_TREE_ATTN=1) while the E5-pinned native arm is BI=0. Per-depth comparisons are argmax/accept-level so this should mostly wash out, but if R2 shows a small UNIFORM deficit across depths (not a step at one depth), a third boot (tree arm BI=0) is needed to exclude BI numerics before concluding anything; B=1 t06 determinism at BI=0 was never directly tested by the bind.
2. Prompts-file format gap (must fix first): fr10_quick_decode_tps_probe._read_prompts (:101-111) is line-based; multiline SWE-4 prompts require the committed .json extension. Using fr12_deliverable_swe4_probe.py instead would silently lose prompt_token_ids pinning and break every downstream reducer (they require the tree_greedy_probe.json + *_request_metrics.jsonl + logs/ run-dir shape).
3. Shared append-only server logs: all windows write the same /logs/*.jsonl; without the snapshot+truncate recipe the variants mix (greedy vs sampled lcp rows are distinguishable by event type, but per_req_spec_trace rows are not). Truncation mid-boot is safe only because the FHs are O_APPEND ('a', buffering=1, patch :3700-3705); verify row counts in each snapshot before truncating, and run the branch oracle only AFTER the native snapshots (its requests append rows).
4. FINAL_LOGIT_CAPTURE counters are process-global with SKIP/LIMIT over NUM_TOKENS-filtered calls (patch :7313-7318): LIMIT=16 means only the FIRST window (greedy) gets logit vectors. The t06 anatomy must rely on committer_step_trace probabilities (sufficient: target_argmax + p-at-draft + canonical_accept_prob are logged per step); if t06 logit vectors are later needed, a re-boot with _SKIP targeted at the (deterministically reproducible) call index is the path.
5. Do NOT run the full fr13_e2e_measure.py / fr13_argmax_lcp_localize.reduce on the graphed boots: reduce() unconditionally loads logs/tree_layer_hidden.call0.pt (fr13_argmax_lcp_localize.py:461-469), and layer-hidden/sub-kernel capture hooks are eager-only (FR13_FLAGS.md:24, FR12 measurement-regime memory). On the graphed pair use compare_deliverable + corruption gate + branch oracle; the layer ladder is a separate EAGER paired boot — and eager-vs-graphs numerics can move the first flip, so re-assert the flip reproduces in the eager pair before binding any sub-op result.
6. t06 per-depth comparison is MARGINAL, not per-event: at temp 0.6 the tree and native streams decouple immediately (different RNG consumption), so R2 compares aggregate rates. ~170-180 events/variant at max_tokens=128 gives binomial 95% CIs of roughly ±0.07 per depth — treat sub-CI gaps as unresolved (raise max-tokens to 256 or add prompts rather than over-reading); exact per-event pairing is the GREEDY battery + branch oracle's job. Note greedy accept/event is CAPPED at the native chain (~3.076) — branches give no greedy speedup (FR13_DECISIVE_TEST.md 'SPEED reality') — so greedy is the LOSSLESS/localization tool, t06 is the deficit measurement.
7. Topology check is not covered by the engagement assert (it only checks draft_count==9): confirm the caterpillar child pattern (step-0 child_node_ids==[0], steps 1-4 == two children) in committer_step_trace before trusting spine==native-chain (project_fr10_drafter_topology_mismatch).
8. Warmup must stay 0 (--warmup-samples 0): warmup requests append identical-token events to the lcp log and corrupt the sequential event aligners. Consequence: do not quote ANY speed/TPS number from this battery (FR10_METRICS=1 + BI=1 + no warmup all bias speed; speed is a separate clean run per FR13_FLAGS.md section D and feedback_dont_handroll_speed).
9. vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens_per_pos_total must exist in this nightly image for the /metrics cross-check — verify with one curl at boot; the trace-derived tables are primary either way. Also note native per-pos /metrics and per_req_spec_trace count accepted DRAFT tokens (bonus excluded) — keep the same convention on both sides of R2.
10. Single GPU + GB10 memory: full docker rm -f + recover_host_memory between boots and at the end (launchers already gate on MemAvailable at start); never docker-restart the containers (wedges ~100GiB, reference_modelserver_host_memory_recovery).
11. If W3 shows ANY tree t06 same-seed mismatch, the deficit numbers still get captured but the 'deterministically reproducible first divergent event' premise of R4 fails — bind the determinism regression first (it would contradict da113115 and likely implicates the FINAL_LOGIT_CAPTURE/FR10_METRICS=1 instrumentation delta vs the bind boot, which ran FR10_METRICS=0).
